title: Lazy's Morathi Ascension (STAGES + RESKINS)
author: LazyIcarus
description:
Get all on steam now: <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3471237702>

Update (2025-01-09)

Rebooted out of hiatus. Morathi's early quest chain with Alith Anar and Malus have been streamlined into quest battles instead of having to fight them on the campaign (save compatible). This should make it a lot easier regardless if they have been defeated / wounded. Since 6.0 there's been a problem with the animation persistent meta where in battle Morathi's feet in heels sinks into the ground. If anyone knows how to resolve the persistent meta issue please let me know in discord.

Update (2023-11-22)

added major AI bonuses to Alith Anar, Malus, Teclis, and N'Kari while playing as Morathi to avoid breaking progression, so that the difficulty of progression is no longer trying to complete the missions in time before they get wiped out, but to defeat stronger foes. Still won't be new content for a while, but I'm open to balancing suggestions for if those mission factions still die out too fast or if they're now too hard.

Update (2023-11-02)

The story is currently incomplete, and I won't be modding WH3 again until a good DLC is released. I will also have to rework some of the earlier missions to be quest battles to avoid AI getting wiped out and breaking progression for some people (even though that's part of the challenge, having RNG of AI behavior decide it can be frustrating). Creating all the different missions and conditions is about 40 times more work than Miao's progression in terms of creation time, so it is sad to see that most would prefer something simpler and more robust. Due to amount of work, seeming lack of interest, and the low ratings, it is being placed in indefinite hiatus.

Gameplay progressive corruption and ascension of Morathi. Each stage mod is standalone and you don't need to have all of them loaded. If you don't have this progression framework, each stage mod will just be a graphical reskin, but with this mod they will also bring significant gameplay changes.
